name: k8s_resource_quota
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes ResourceQuota. A ResourceQuota enforces per-namespace compute and object limits.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this resource quota.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the resource quota. Must be a DNS-1123 label (lowercase alphanumeric and '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric).

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this resource quota belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the resource quota is applied to.

attributes.name: hard
attributes.description: Hard resource limits enforced by this quota. Keys are Kubernetes resource names (e.g. "cpu", "memory", "pods", "requests.cpu", "limits.memory") and values are Kubernetes quantity strings (e.g. "4", "8Gi", "100").

attributes.name: scopes
attributes.description: Optional list of scopes that restrict which resources this quota applies to (e.g. "Terminating", "NotTerminating", "BestEffort", "NotBestEffort", "PriorityClass"). Immutable: changing this value forces replacement of the resource quota.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the resource quota. Send-only: the server injects its own duplocloud.ai/* labels, so this value is not read back to avoid spurious drift.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the resource quota. Send-only (not read back).

attributes.name: k8s_resource_quota_id
attributes.description: ID of this resource quota, for reference by dependent resources.
